Tureas Construction LLC is a dynamic and rapidly growing multi-sector company established in May 2021 and headquartered in Mogadishu, Somalia — founded by a team of highly specialized Somali-Turkish business professionals.

We are a trusted partner for government agencies, international organizations, NGOs, private enterprises and investors seeking reliable construction, engineering and logistics solutions in Somalia and the Horn of Africa.
Our management team combines deep local knowledge with international business and technical expertise — delivering world-class standards adapted to the Somali operating environment.
